criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: tests using fixture records in a temporary directory show that after `review` with each verdict (right, existing class, new class, with and without a note) a class-label record exists with the expected class, note and labeled_by person, and the introspection file is byte-identical.
criteria.evidence: tests/review.rs covers three cases on fixture records in a temporary repository: right with a note, existing class without a note (the test also checks there is no `note` key in the file), and new class with a note. Each test asserts the class, note and labeled_by == Person, and that introspection_bytes is unchanged. All 8 tests passed.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test shows that after a review `labeled::build` no longer counts the introspection as unreviewed (`unreviewed` drops by one).
criteria.evidence: In the test right_records_the_introspections_own_class..., `build(...).excluded.unreviewed` goes from 3 to 2 after the review. A unit test in labeled.rs also checks that `unreviewed` agrees with `build`. Both passed.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test shows `athena status` (StatusView and its display) reports the number of unreviewed introspections and that the count falls after a review. When the count is above zero, `next` hints at `athena review`.
criteria.evidence: In status_counts_unreviewed_introspections_and_the_count_falls_after_a_review, the JSON field `unreviewed_introspections` goes 3, then 2, then 0. The text display shows `unreviewed  3 introspection(s) with no class label`. A `next` line starts with `athena review <id>` when the count is above zero and is gone at zero. Passed.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: tests show errors write nothing: unknown introspection id, unknown class id, no verdict flag, two verdict flags, `--right` on an introspection with no class, and a multi-line note.
criteria.evidence: errors_write_nothing covers every listed case and a few more (bad class id format, missing description, duplicate class name, ambiguous prefix). For each, the `refused` helper asserts a non-zero exit, that HEAD is unchanged, that the tree is clean, that there are no labels and that there are still 2 classes. Passed.

criteria.criterion: `cargo clippy` (workspace, all targets) is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
criteria.evidence: Both finished with no warnings or diffs.

criteria.criterion: `ClassLabel` in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs has an optional `note` field that is absent from the JSON when None. A round-trip test covers both with and without a note, and the existing label test still passes.
criteria.evidence: In the diff, `note: Option<String>` carries `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]`. The existing class-label test now asserts there is no `note` in the JSON when it is None, and round-trips a label with a note. The full test run passed.

criteria.criterion: The review output shows what happened, class (name and id), cause, prevention, and Jev's shadow class choice and probabilities, or says Jev was not asked or failed.
criteria.evidence: display::review prints the lines what happened, class (`name (id)` via class_text), cause, prevention (`kind: text`) and jev (shadow): either the choice, confidence and each option's probability with its name, or `Jev was not asked` / `Jev failed: ...`. The test the_output_shows_the_record_and_jev_s_shadow_answer checks this.

criteria.criterion: README.md's command table lists `athena review` and notes the status count. CHANGELOG.md has an entry. The docs that describe `athena.class-label/1` (docs/design/defaults-loop.md section 10.2) mention the note and that the build now writes these records.
criteria.evidence: README has a new table row for `athena review` that mentions the status count. CHANGELOG has an Added entry, and the older entry no longer says 'nothing writes it'. defaults-loop.md §10.2 has a new 'Class labels' bullet covering the note and the writer, and the §12 step-6 text was updated. docs/records.md has a row for the record.

summary: The change does what was asked. `athena review <id>` shows the introspection: what happened, the class as name and id, cause, prevention, and Jev's shadow choice and probabilities, or a line saying Jev was not asked or failed. In the same call it commits an `athena.class-label/1` record with `labeled_by` set to person. The verdict is one of `--right`, `--class` or `--new-class`/`--description`; a new class is written as a proposed `athena.failure-class/1` record in the same commit. An optional one-line `--note` is stored in a new optional `ClassLabel.note` field, which is left out of the JSON when empty. The introspection file is never touched, and the tests check that it stays byte-identical. `athena status` now shows the unreviewed count and adds a `next` hint pointing at `athena review`. The count comes from `labeled::unreviewed`, the same helper `labeled::build` uses. I ran the full `cargo test --locked` (all pass, including 8 new CLI tests in tests/review.rs and new unit tests), `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` (clean) and `cargo fmt --all --check` (passes). README, CHANGELOG, docs/design/defaults-loop.md §10.2 and §12, and docs/records.md are updated, and what they say matches the code. The changed files are exactly the expected deliverables. I found no problems.
